requests.original_text: In every way, God, according to his promise, will make Abraham's seed a blessing to mankind.
requests.claim: 하나님은 아브라함의 자손을 인간에게 축복으로 만드실 것이라고 약속하셨다.

requests.original_text: Joab could say to his brother, Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God ; and the Lord do that which seemeth him good* 2 Sam. x. 12.
requests.claim: 군대 지휘관은 종교적 신앙이 없더라도 전쟁 중에 하나님의 도움을 기대하며 자신과 군대를 강화할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: The promulgation of a re- ligion adapted to man, it is said, should be as extensive as the globe.
requests.claim: 하나님의 종교는 지구 전체에 걸쳐 널리 전파되어야 한다.

requests.original_text: It is observable, that in the dispensations of mercy, God has in a wonderful manner, balanced the affairs of men, so as, upon the whole, to answer the most important ends in the great system of moral government.
requests.claim: 하나님의 섭리는 인류의 삶을 놀라운 방식으로 균형을 이루어 도덕적 정부의 중요한 목적을 달성한다.

requests.original_text: This is said to be the usual posture of eminent teachers among the Jews.
requests.claim: 유대인 중에서 저명한 교사들은 일반적으로 앉아서 가르쳤다는 사실이 말해지고 있다.

requests.original_text: Say ye to the wicked, it shall be ill with him, — There is no peace saith my Ged, unto the wicked.
requests.claim: 하나님의 평화는 악한 자에게는 없다는 말

requests.original_text: In saying, " The gospel has no comfort for impenitent, though distressed sinners in their pres- ent state," I meant, It promises no mercy but on supposition of their comin<* off from that state to Jesus Christ.
requests.claim: 복음은 현재 상태에서 회개하지 않는 죄인에게는 자비를 약속하지 않으며, 예수 그리스도께로 돌아오는 것을 전제로 합니다.

requests.original_text: But if he tell me his tale of woe, un- der an idea that something may bejound in it to which the promises of mercy are made, (and such cases are not uncommon,) I should answer, Think nothing of this, my friend; unless your distress lead you to relinquish every false way, and to cast yourself as a perishing sinner on Jesus Christ for salva- tion, it is of no account.
requests.claim: 구원은 오직 예수 그리스도를 통해 이루어지며, 고통이나 다른 요소는 구원에 직접적인 영향을 미치지 않는다.

requests.original_text: Blessed are they that hunger and thirst after righteous- Jiess, &c. — It is a truth, that the obedience of Jesus unto death which is the righteousness on account of which believers are jus- tified, is the object of their most intense desire ; but, as this is less introduced prior to its being actually wrought than afterwards, I doubt not but that the term in this place refers to the universal prevalence of righteousness in the mind and in the world.
requests.claim: 의지와 갈망이 의로운 삶을 사는 것에 집중되어야 하며, 이는 믿는 자들의 가장 강렬한 열망의 대상이다.

requests.original_text: Who would have thought that a man could be persecuted and reviled, and have all manner of evil said of him, for righteous- ness' sake?
requests.claim: 인간은 의로운 일을 하기 때문에 박해를 받고 욕을 들어도 의로운 삶을 살 수 있다.

requests.original_text: Only see to it that whatever you suffer, be for righteousness* sake, and that all the evil which is said of you be/a/*e, and for Christ's sake, and instead of being discouraged, you will have reason to rejoice and be exceedingly glad.
requests.claim: 그리스도와 의의 sake를 위해 고난을 겪는 것은 기뻐하고 매우 기쁜 이유가 된다.

requests.original_text: Being about to correct various corrup- tions which had obtained among the Jews, he prefaces what he has to say, by cautioning them not to misconstrue his design, as though he were setting himself against either Moses or the prophets, neither of whose writings were at variance with his kingdom, but preparatory to it.
requests.claim: 예수 그리스도는 율법 자체를 폐지하려는 것이 아니라, 율법의 부패한 관행을 바로잡으려는 것이었다.

requests.original_text: The best means of preventing both, is to examine thyself in thy most solemn ap- proaches to God : for then if ever the conscience is tender, and likely to bring to remembrance what is wrong between thee and thy brother.' What must 1 do, say you, who have offended my brother?
requests.claim: 신앙인으로서 형제와의 관계를 회복하기 위해 하나님께 드리는 가장 효과적인 방법은 양심을 살피고, 잘못된 부분을 기억하는 것

requests.original_text: We are often told by the adversaries of the atonement, that God is never said to be reconciled to us by the death of Christ, but to have reconciled us to himself by it.
requests.claim: 하나님의 화해는 우리를 하나님께로 화해시키는 것을 의미한다.

requests.original_text: Say not, our differences shall be tried by legal judges, whatever be the con- sequences : but offer just and generous terms whilst thou art in the way with him, that if the breach can be healed it may, or if not, that the fault may not lie at thy door.' It were desirable that there were no strife among us, and if we loved one another as God's law requires, there would be none : but seeing it is other- wise, the same principle which in innocent creatures would ope- rate to prevent it, must in guilty creatures operate to heal it.
requests.claim: 신앙과 사랑의 원칙에 따라 갈등을 해결하고 화해할 수 있어야 하며, 이를 통해 관계를 회복하고 죄를 회피할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: They had heard that it was said to them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery ; and they had heard the truth : but the pharisaical glosses would confine its meaning, as in the former instance, to outward actions ; whereas in its true intent, it comprehended the inward affections of the mind, censuring the wanton look, and the impure desire.
requests.claim: 유대인 전통의 제7계명은 외적인 행동뿐만 아니라 내적인 욕망도 포함한다

requests.original_text: What our Lord says of swearing may have respect to the third commandment, in which we are forbidden to take the name of the Lord our God in vain.
requests.claim: 주님의 말씀은 세 번째 계명을 언급하고 있으며, 그 계명에서는 주 우리 하나님의 이름을 헛되이 쓰지 말라고 금지하고 있다.

requests.original_text: It had also been said, Thou skalt not swear by my name falsely ; neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God.
requests.claim: 하나님께 거짓으로 맹세하지 말고 하나님의 이름을 욕되게 하지 말라

requests.original_text: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in nowise pass from the law tilt all be fulfilled.
requests.claim: 예수 그리스도는 율법과 예언서를 폐지하러 오지 않고, 그것을 완성하러 왔으며, 하늘과 땅이 사라질 때까지 율법의 한 점이나 한 획도 사라지지 않고 모두 성취될 때까지 남아있다.

requests.original_text: If it be objected, that though Christ did not destroy the moral law, yet there were various precepts pertaining to the ceremonial and judicial laws of Israel, which on his appearance ceased to be binding, and that oaths might be of this description — I answer, In abolishing things which had been of divine authority, he is never
requests.claim: 그리스도께서는 하나님의 권위가 있었던 것들을 폐지할 때는 결코

requests.original_text: He could not therefore be said to have destroyed even the ceremonial law, but rather to have fulfilled it.
requests.claim: 그는 예배의 법을 파괴한 것이 아니라, 오히려 그것을 성취했다.

requests.original_text: But the oaths against which he inveighs, are expressly said to come of evil; and therefore could never have been of divine authority.
requests.claim: 예수님은 악한 것으로부터 비롯된 서약에 대해 비난하였으며, 그러한 서약은 결코 신의 권위로부터 비롯될 수 없었다.

requests.original_text: He did not censure his countrymen for what was said before a magistrate to put an end to strife ; but for what passed in their ordinary communications, (ver. 37>) that is, for light and unnecessary oaths, by which the name of God was profaned.
requests.claim: 예수 그리스도는 일상적인 대화에서 가벼운 맹세와 불필요한 맹세를 통해 하나님의 이름을 욕되게 하는 유대인들의 죄를 책망하셨다.

requests.original_text: The same may be said of all such phrases as the following— Of faith, By my troth, Upon my soul, Upon my life, Upon my honour, nnd even Upon my word.
requests.claim: 특정 구절의 언어 사용은 악한 것에서 비롯된다.

requests.original_text: If, said he, I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil ; but if well, why smitest thou me ?
requests.claim: 예수는 자신이 잘못한 말을 했다면 증거를 들어 잘못을 증명해 주고, 아니라면 자신을 때리는 것을 왜 하는지 물었다.

requests.original_text: In this remonstrance, however, he was not influenced by a spirit of retaliation, but of justice to his own character, which, under the form of striking his person, was as- saulted ; and what he said had a tendency to convict the party and the assembly.
requests.claim: 예수님의 항변은 개인의 명예를 위한 정의를 위한 것이었으며, 그 발언은 상대방과 회중을 책망하는 의도였다.

requests.original_text: When they rejected the <*ospel, he did not scruple to apply to them the awful prophecies of Isaiah Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand ; and seeing ye shall see and shall not perceive, &c. yet the same apostle solemnly declares, that he had great heaviness, and continual sorrow in his heart on their behalf.
requests.claim: 바울은 유대인들이 복음을 거절했을 때 이사야의 예언을 적용했지만 그들의 영적 상태에 대해 깊은 슬픔을 느꼈다.

requests.original_text: Benevolence has not, as observed before, an immediate respect to character ; yet it considers its objects within the limits of hope, in respect to their becoming the friends of God.
requests.claim: 인간의 선행은 하나님의 친구가 될 가능성이 있는 사람들을 고려한다

requests.original_text: If our love be directed merely " to that which relieves us," it would be equally worthy of acceptation in our account, let- that relief come how it might; and thus the character of God as the just and the justifier of them that believe in Jesus, forms no part of the good news to sinful men : the glory of the gospel is no
requests.claim: 하나님의 영광과 의를 위한 복음의 가치는 우리의 구원에 대한 이해와 관련이 있다.

requests.original_text: They might have said, ■ We have enough to do to provide for our own houses : it is for the rich, and not for labouring people, to give alms.' But feeling, as they did, for the afflicted and necessitous, especially for those of the household of faith, they would deny themselves many comforts for the sake of being able to relieve them.
requests.claim: 진정한 신앙은 사람들에게 자비를 가르친다.

requests.original_text: The liberality of vain men, having no other object than to be thought generous, is commonly, either publicly proclaimed, or exercised in a way that shall by some means come to the knowledge of the neighbourhood ; while that of the modest Christian, desirous only of approving himself to God, is done in secret.
requests.claim: 겸손한 기독교인의 자선은 비밀리에 행해지지만, 허영심에 사로잡힌 사람들의 자선은 대중에게 알려지기 위해 공개적으로 행해진다.

requests.original_text: What he says is not to persuade them to prayer, but to direct them in it.
requests.claim: 그리스도의 제자는 기도하는 사람들이다.

requests.original_text: Infidels may imagine that God does not concern himself with the affairs of mortals, and may excuse themselves by pretending that it were presumption in them to solicit the Supreme Being to do this or that : formalists may say their prayers, and be glad when the task is over : but Christians cannot live without communion with God.
requests.claim: 그리스도인들은 하나님과의 교제 없이는 살 수 없다.

requests.original_text: To satisfy Ananias that Saul was become n Christian, it was enough to say, Behold, he prayeth !
requests.claim: 기도는 기독교인임을 증명하는 충분한 증거이다.

requests.original_text: What is said of the privacy of prayer will literally apply to that which is personal, or expressive of individual desire.
requests.claim: 개인적인 기도는 개인의 개인적인 바람을 표현하는 것으로, 이러한 기도는 개인의 사적인 공간에서 행해져야 한다.

requests.original_text: His object was not to appoint the place or the posture of prayer ; but to detect the vanity of the mind, and to direct his followers to seek the appro- bation of God, rather than the applauses of men.
requests.claim: 그리스도께서는 기도하는 곳이나 자세가 아니라, 사람들 앞에서 기도하는 것을 통해 사람들의 인정과 칭찬을 추구하는 마음의 허영심을 비판하셨고, 오히려 하나님의 인정과 기뻐함을 추구하도록 그의 추종자들에게 가르치셨다.

requests.original_text: Verily I say unto you, they have their reward/ God will apportion our rewards according to the things we seek.
requests.claim: 하나님은 우리가 추구하는 것에 따라 우리의 상을 나눠주실 것이다.

requests.original_text: It is not, how- ever, for the purpose of inspiring reverence only ,Tthat God is said to be in heaven, but to encourage us to confide in his absolute su- premacy, and almighty power.
requests.claim: 하나님은 우리에게 경외와 신뢰를 동시에 일으키기 위해 절대적 주권과 전능을 가지고 계신다.

requests.original_text: When the heathen triumphed over the church, and sneeringly asked each other, Where is now their God? it was suffi- cient to answer, Our God is in the heavens, he hath done whatso- ever he hath pleased.
requests.claim: 하나님의 주권은 그의 백성들이 어려움에 직면하더라도 하나님은 하늘에 계시며 그의 뜻을 이루신다는 사실에 위안을 찾을 수 있다.

requests.original_text: That which some have denominated ** disinterested love," or the love of God for what he is in himself, as far as I understand it, is no other than hallow- in<* his name, which is essential to true religion.
requests.claim: 진정한 종교의 본질은 하나님의 이름을 거룩하게 하는 것과 관련된 하나님에 대한 사랑이다.

requests.original_text: It is to this end that God himself pursues these great objects ; to this end therefore we must pray for them.
requests.claim: 하나님의 이름의 영광을 위해 하나님은 우리가 기도해야 할 큰 목표들을 추구하신다.

requests.original_text: Or if the satisfaction made by Christ in our stead had been on the principle of debtor and creditor, whatever obligation we might have been under to the surety, or to the cred- itor for providing him, the debt could not be said to have been for- given.
requests.claim: 그리스도께서 우리를 대신하여 이루신 속죄는 채무자와 채권자 간의 원칙에 따라 이루어졌다면, 우리가 보증인이나 채권자에게 부담한 의무와 상관없이, 그 부채는 사면된 것으로 간주될 수 없다.

requests.original_text: As justification includes forgiveness, we may be said to be fully forgiven from the first moment that we believe in Christ ; but it is in some such way I conceive as we are said to be glorified.
requests.claim: 우리는 그리스도에게 믿음으로부터 첫 순간부터 완전히 용서를 받았다고 말할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: It is not enough to say, we cannot expect the comfort of it : we cannot expect the thing itself.
requests.claim: 우리는 우리가 다른 사람에게 용서를 거부하는 동안 하나님께서는 우리에게 용서를 주시지 않는다.

requests.original_text: Christ indeed went into the field of contest, and came out unhurt ; but this is more than can be said with certainty of any of his followers.
requests.claim: 그리스도는 유혹의 시험장에 들어가서 무사히 나왔지만, 그의 모든 추종자에게도 그런 것을 확신할 수 없다.

requests.original_text: Many a man would have killed Saul in the cave of Adullam, and have pleaded, as David's servants did, that the Loid had delivered his enemy into his hand: but so did not David, because of the fear of God.— I o"nly add, There is no necess iry connexion between going into temptation and coming out of it.
requests.claim: 하나님의 두려움을 가진 사람들은 기회가 있더라도 자기 이익을 위해 행동하지 않는다.

requests.original_text: The concluding doxology, though omitted by Luke, and thought by some not to have been originally included by Matthew, appears to agree with the foregoing petitions, and to furnish encourage- ment to hope for an answer.
requests.claim: 마태복음의 결론적 도살자가 앞서간 기도들과 일치하며, 응답에 대한 희망을 주는 것으로 보인다.

requests.original_text: A single eye has but one object, and this is God.* It is opposed to an evil eye.
requests.claim: 하나님의 영으로 충만한 영적 시각은 오직 하나님만을 향한 단 하나의 목적을 가지고 있다.

requests.original_text: The one is expressive of that spirituality of mind, which, as the Apostle says, approves the excellent, Phil. i. 10.
requests.claim: 하나님의 영적인 마음은 우수한 것을 인정한다.

requests.original_text: It is as though he had said, Seeing you cannot serve two masters, serve the Lord ; and as you must not look two ways, let your eye be single, keeping one great end in view, and treating everything else as a secondary or subordinate object.
requests.claim: 세상적인 근심을 버리고 하나님만 섬기라

requests.original_text: " All men," says Calvin, on the passage, " do flatter and spare themselves ; and every man is a severe censor against others.
requests.claim: 인간은 자신을 용서하고 다른 사람을 엄격하게 판단하는 경향이 있다.

requests.original_text: This wicked delight in biting, carping, and slandering, doth Christ forbid, when he saith, Judge not."
requests.claim: 그리스도는 비방과 중상모략의 악한 즐거움을 금지하셨다.

requests.original_text: Though we should reprove men from the purest motives, yet if what we say, be harsh or unseasonable, instead of doing them go^d, we shall provoke their resentment, and do both them and ourselves harm.
requests.claim: 순수한 동기에서 비록 사람들을 책망하더라도, 우리가 말하는 것이 거친 말이나 때가 아닌 말이라면, 그들에게 선을 행하는 대신에 그들의 분노를 자극하여 그들과 우리에게 모두 해를 끼칠 수 있다.

requests.original_text: We see in it a union of zeal, which never lost sight of its object, and of discretion which selected the best means, and seized the fittest opportunities for accomplishing it.
requests.claim: 열정과 재량이 결합하여 목적을 달성하기 위한 최선의 수단과 기회를 선택한다.

requests.original_text: Observe the terms by which it is expressed — asking, seeking, knocking.
requests.claim: 하나님께서는 기도하는 자들에게 무엇을 구할 것인지에 대해 구체적으로 언급하지 않으셨지만, 구원주를 통해 모든 필요를 풍성히 제공하시고 하나님께 나아가는 길을 열어주셨다.

requests.original_text: The formalist rests in the deed done, but the believer in Jesus thinks not of his own seekings, but of the objects sought.
requests.claim: 진정한 기도는 자아를 넘어서 위에서 도움을 찾는 것에 있다.

requests.original_text: It is as if he had said, If you walk in the way which I have been warning you against, the entrance will be easy, and you will meet with but few obstructions in your progress.
requests.claim: 주님은 사람들에게 경고한 길을 걸으면 출입이 쉽고, 거의 장애물 없이 진행할 수 있다고 말하고 있다.

requests.original_text: Whatever may be said in favour of ordination from any order of men, it is not this that will render us true ministers.
requests.claim: 인위적인 임직이나 외적인 구별이 진정한 사역자를 만들지 않는다.

requests.original_text: The sum of what he says is, that mere profession will avail nothing, and that real prac- tical godliness is the only thing which in that day will be ap- proved.
requests.claim: 오직 실제적인 신앙의 실천만이 최후의 심판에서 승인될 것이라는 말

requests.original_text: It is not what we say, but what we do, that will be admitted as evidence in that day.
requests.claim: 말하는 것이 아니라 행동하는 것이 중요하다

requests.original_text: Many who in this^world have said, Lord, Lord, in a way of high profession, will, in that day, repeat their words with very different sensations, and with earnest importunity for admit- tance, but all in vain.
requests.claim: 많은 사람들이 이 세상에서 높은 신앙을 고백했음에도 불구하고, 마지막 날에 그들은 입장 허가를 간절히 청할 것이나, 모두 허무한 노력으로 끝날 것이다.

requests.original_text: We see here, say some, that it is by doing, rather than by believing, that we shall stand approved !
requests.claim: 믿음보다 행함으로 인해 우리가 승인될 것이라는 주장

requests.original_text: Moreover, the doc- trine of Christ's sayings is not the rock, but the building upon it. — We see, say others, that it matters but little what doctrines we believe, provided we lead a good life ; it is not by what we have believed, but by what we have done, that we shall be judged ?
requests.claim: 믿음 자체는 그리스도의 말씀의 진리를 실천적으로 확신하는 것이며, 그의 계명에 대한 순종의 과정에 따라 따른다.

requests.original_text: " Take heed," said he to the spectators who surround- ed his bed, M of relying on that faith which works not a holy and unblamable life, worthy of a believer.
requests.claim: 성도들은 믿음이 거룩하고 비난받지 않을 삶을 만들어내지 않는다면, 그 믿음을 의지해서는 안 된다.

requests.original_text: I have tried ; I presumed I had gotten the right faith ; I preached it to others ; I had all places in scripture in memory that might support it ; I thought myself sure, and in the mean time lived im- piously and carelessly ; and behold now the judgment of God hath overtaken me, not to correction, but to damnation."
requests.claim: 오직 외적인 신앙과 성경 지식만으로는 구원에 이르지 못하며, 오히려 하나님의 심판을 받을 수 있다.

requests.original_text: There is certainly an air of reproof contained in the answer : ver. 4 — 6.
requests.claim: 요한복음 4-6절의 대답에는 확실히 책망의 어조가 담겨 있다.

requests.original_text: Jesus would not say whether he was the Messiah, or not ; but left it for his works, and their correspond- ence with prophecy, to determine the question.
requests.claim: 예수는 자신이 메시아인지 여부를 직접 말하지 않고, 자신의 행적과 예언과의 일치로 판단하도록 남겼다.

requests.original_text: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
requests.claim: 하나님은 우리가 고통받은 날과 악을 본 해의 수를 기뻐하는 날로 바꾸어 주시기를 간구한다.

requests.original_text: He neither exempts them from chastisement, nor contends with them for ever.
requests.claim: 하나님은 그의 백성에게 악과 선을 균형 있게 주시며, 그들을 징계에서 완전히 면제하지 않으며, 영원히 그들과 다투지 않으신다.

requests.original_text: They are made glad according to the days in which they were afflicted, and the years in which they had seen evil.
requests.claim: 하나님의 백성은 과거의 고통의 날과 악한 년의 수에 비례하여 기쁨을 받는다.

requests.original_text: Finally, the great afflictions of the church during the successive overturnings of the monarchies, issued, according to Ezekiel's prophecy, (chap. xxi. xxvii.) in Christ's coming and kingdom.
requests.claim: 교회가 겪는 큰 고난은 결국 예레미야의 예언에 따라 그리스도의 오심과 왕국으로 이어진다.

requests.original_text: A cruel and faithless hus- band, a peevish and unamiable wife, or a disobedient child, may- cause us to say with Rebekah, What good does my life do me ?
requests.claim: 가정 내의 어려움이나 갈등은 삶의 즐거움을 빼앗을 수 있다.

requests.original_text: If an evangelical minister among us be called to contend for the purity, spirituality, and per- petual authority of the divine law, or for any particular branch of practical godliness ; it is not unusual for others, who are very differently affected to evangelical truth, to claim kindred with him, and to wish to have it thought that all the suspicions that had beea entertained of them, were merely owing to their zeal for holiness.
requests.claim: 일부 복음주의 목사들이 하나님의 법의 순수성, 영성, 그리고 영속적인 권위를 위해 혹은 실제적인 경건의 특정한 부분을 위해 싸울 때, 다른 사람들은 그들과 관련을 주장하고 그들이 받은 의심이 오직 경건에 대한 열정 때문이라고 주장한다.

requests.original_text: Once have I spoken, but I will xot answer ; yea, twice, but I will proceed no further. — Thou shalt be justified when thou speakest, and clear when thou judgest. — If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquity t O Lordt who shall stand?-*- God be merciful to me a sinner.
requests.claim: 하나님은 의로우시고, 인간은 죄로 인해 의롭지 못하므로 하나님의 자비가 필요하다.

requests.original_text: Fibst : You inquire, " Whether any person by nature pos- sesses that l honest heart,' which constitutes the ability to comply with the invitations of the gospel ?" I believe the heart of man to be by nature the direct opposite of honest.
requests.claim: 인간의 본성은 성실한 마음을 소유하지 않는다.

requests.original_text: I have said, " There is no ability wanting for this purpose in any man who possesses an honest heart." If a person owed you one hundred pounds, and could find plenty of money for his own pur- poses, though none for you ; and should he at the same time plead inability, you would answer, there is no ability wanting, but an honest heart : yet it would be an unjust construction of your words, if an advocate for this dishonest man were to allege, that you had represented an honest heart as that which constituted the ability to pay the debt.
requests.claim: 진정한 마음은 복음의 초대에 응할 수 있는 능력의 조건이다.

requests.original_text: Secondly : If no man by nature possess an honest heart, you inquire, " Whether, if I be not what you call an elect sinner, there are many means provided of God, and which I can use, that shall issue in that ' honesty of heart,' which will enable me to believe unto salvation ?" Your being an elect, or a non-elect sinner, makes no difference as to this question.
requests.claim: 선택받은 자 또는 선택되지 않은 자의 지위는 구원에 이르는 믿음에 필요한 정직한 마음을 얻기 위한 수단의 사용과는 무관하다.

requests.original_text: Probably you your- self would not plead for such a use of means ; but would allow, that even in using means to obtain an honest heart, we ought to be sincere : but, if so, you must maintain what I affirm, that no- thing short of honesty of heart itself is required in any of the ex- hortations of scripture ; for a sincere use of means is honesty of heart.
requests.claim: 성경의 모든 권고에서 진정한 마음의 정직함이 요구된다.

requests.original_text: If you say, i No ; man is depraved : it is not his duty to possess an honest heart, but merely to use means that he may pos- sess it :' I answer, (as personating the sinner,) I have no desire after an honest heart.
requests.claim: 인간은 진정한 마음을 소유할 의무가 아니라 진정한 마음을 소유하기 위해 수단을 사용할 의무만 있다.

requests.original_text: Thirdly : You inquire, If there be no means provided of God, which I can use, that shall issue in that honesty of heart which will enable me to believe unto salvation, " how can the gospel be o» blessing bestowed upon me ; seeing it is inadequate to make me happy, and contains no good thing which I can possibly obtain or enjoy ?" If I be under no other inability than that which arises from a dishonesty of heart, it is an abuse of language to introduce the terms " possible, impossible," &c. for the purpose of dimin- ishing the goodness of God, or destroying the accountableness of man.
requests.claim: 만약 하나님께서 구원에 이르는 믿음을 가능하게 하는 수단을 제공하지 않는다면, 복음은 나에게 축복이 될 수 없으며, 행복을 주거나 좋은 것을 주는 데 불충분하다.

requests.original_text: If I be so wicked as not only to be destitute of an honest heart, but cannot be persuaded to use means iti order to obtain it, I must per- ish : and then, according to your way of writing, the gospel was " inadequate to make me happy, and was no blessing to me !" You will say, ' 1 might have used the means,' that is, I might if I would, or if I had possessed a sincere desire after the end : but I did not possess it ; and therefore the same consequences follow your hypotheses, as that which you oppose.
requests.claim: 만약 내가 정직한 마음을 가지지 못하고, 그것을 얻기 위해 필요한 수단을 사용하도록 설득되지 않는다면, 나는 멸망할 것이며, 복음은 나를 행복하게 만들기에 불충분하며, 나에게는 축복이 아니다.

requests.original_text: Let a man feel that there is no bar between him and heaven, ex- cept what consists in his own wickedness ; and yet that such is its influence over him, that he certainly never will, by any efforts of his own, extricate himself from it ; and he will then begin to pray for an interest in salvation by mere grace, in the name of Jesus — a salvation that will save him from himself; and so praying, he will find it : and when he has found it, he will feel and acknowledge that it was grace alone that made him to differ ; and this grace he is taught in the scriptures to ascribe to the purpose of God, given him in Christ Jesus before the world began.
requests.claim: 인간은 자신의 악행이 천국과 자신 사이의 유일한 장애물임을 느끼고, 그 악행에서 스스로 벗어날 수 없다는 것을 알게 되면, 예수님의 이름으로 오직 은혜로 말미암는 구원에 대한 관심을 위해 기도하기 시작하며, 이 기도를 통해 그 구원을 발견하게 되고, 그 구원을 발견한 후에는 오직 은혜로 인해 자신이 다른 사람과 다름을 느끼고, 이 은혜를 성경에서 가르치는 대로 그리스도 예수 안에서 세상을 창조하기 전에 주신 하나님의 목적에 돌려야 한다.

requests.original_text: Beloved, when I gave diligence to write unto you of the common salva- tion, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you, that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
requests.claim: 성도들은 한 번 성도들에게 전달된 신앙을 열심히 위해 싸워야 한다.

requests.original_text: It is as if the writer had said, If the enemy had levelled his weapon against any thing but the very heart of the gospel, 1 might have held my peace.
requests.claim: 복음의 핵심을 공격하는 것은 다른 어떤 것보다도 더 심각한 문제이다.

requests.original_text: In discoursing on the subject, I shall endeavour to ascertain wherein the common salvation consists ; inquire why it is so called ; and show the importance of its being made the grand theme of our ministrations, and the first object of our attachment.
requests.claim: 구원은 설교와 신앙의 중심 주제가 되어야 하며, 그 중요성을 강조해야 한다.

requests.original_text: It is the same thing as the faith once, delivered to the saints : the common faith, after which Titus is said to have been begotten.
requests.claim: 복음의 구원은 성도들에게 한 번 전달된 믿음과 동일하다.

requests.original_text: For I delivered unto you first of all, that which 1 also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures ; and that he was buried, and that he rose a°ain the. third day, according to the scriptures.
requests.claim: 그리스도는 우리의 죄를 위하여 성경에 따라 죽으시고, 매장되셨으며, 세 번째 날에 성경에 따라 다시 살아나셨다.

requests.original_text: John had more of the affectionate : he was baptized, as it were, in love ; but the Lamb that was slain was the great object of it.
requests.claim: 요한은 사랑에 대한 감정을 많이 가지고 있었고, 그가 사랑하는 대상은 희생된 어린 양이었다.

requests.original_text: There is no other name, said Peter, given under heaven, or among men, whereby we must be saved ; and John stood by his side and as- sented.
requests.claim: 예수 그리스도의 이름 외에는 우리가 구원받을 수 있는 다른 이름은 없다.

requests.original_text: A real Christian cannot object to either of those four things which were considered as belonging to the common salva- tion : — to the necessity of it, the vicarious medium of it, the free- ness of it, or its holy efficacy.
requests.claim: 진정한 기독교인은 구원의 필요성, 대속적 매개, 자유, 및 거룩한 효능에 대해 반대할 수 없다.
